scope: Source quotations, review integrity and separation from runtime; not independent semantic acceptance

checks.name: All 1772 missing qids and 3539 applicable game gaps are accounted for once
Pinned repository text inventory is complete and every downloaded byte matches its manifest
Every quoted Chinese character is an unchanged range of a real original source entry
All confirmed findings have their own applicable per-game source witnesses
Semantic homonyms and English localization mismatches cannot count as confirmed matches
Braille stays meaningful pending text rather than being discarded as punctuation
Original semantic queries retrieve saving messages without relying on address or original English
Search normalization preserves negation and numeric differences; it never licenses a match alone
Both retrieval and semantic-review manifests reproduce their current inputs and outputs
Runtime and base RSC-only packages remain unchanged and verifiable
